context.receipt_diagnostic: closed residual has no kernel-decidable result within the admitted replay surface
context.supported_inference: Both existing polarity compilations failed to construct an admitted result theorem; their detailed compiler diagnostics were discarded. The implementation provides one direct kernel-decision recipe.
context.unsupported_inference: The permitted receipt does not identify a particular Lean primitive, cast, instance, reduction rule, heartbeat failure or source defect. It does not establish that the mathematical residual is undecidable or false.
context.independent_limitation: Incomplete carrier inspection is a separate review limitation. Improving ground replay cannot by itself complete that inspection or turn the sealed ballot into ACCEPT.
context.sealed_run_policy: Retain the incident run and all receipts unchanged. Do not rerun, rescore or repair it under this design. Any later implementation and review require a new candidate/root.

generic_references.scope: Constructive search, immutable receipts and incomplete review

public_claims_proposed_for_qualification.text: A selected finite normalization recipe can discharge the declared unrelated ground-replay fixture surface within the existing replay limits.

Every definitive observation is established by a safe theorem of the exact original grounded predicate or its negation, independently replayed against bound inputs under the unchanged TCB and axiom policy.
An unresolved construction retains bounded diagnostics and remains unsupported; it cannot become a completed acceptance search or a confirmed violation.
The future qualification is reproducible across two isolated clean builds of one frozen unrelated fixture and verifier surface.

invariants.ground_expression: Retain the existing strict sort-directed assignment decoding, outermost universal instantiation, original local binders and source-call substitution. Normalize only the proof state or proof construction; never replace the accepted formula, precondition, binder inventory or result theorem type.
invariants.exact_result: For original closed expression E, the only definitive result theorem types are exactly E and Not E. Export and check the exact type, ground-expression hash, safety, empty universe parameter list, absence of unresolved constants and kernel defeq response.
invariants.source_authority: Actual source bytes, reconstructed AST, accepted formula/profile/certificate, bridge relation, source-only correspondence, normative library modules and toolchain dependencies must remain bound to their current exact identities.
invariants.closure_authority: Independently replay the complete normative library, accepted contract, supervisor goal and probe closure. Check exact staged-module inventory and allowed toolchain import roots. Preserve the current treatment of runtime _unsafe_rec declarations; do not enlarge the exception inventory.
invariants.axioms_and_trust: Use the current policy.classify_axiom acceptance rule and the existing declared TCB. No new trusted evaluator, oracle, imported axiom, runtime observation or axiom-policy exception is permitted.
invariants.proof_construction: The generator and all normalization proposals are untrusted. A successful compiler exit, printed Boolean, proposed normalized AST or source hash alone is not observation evidence.
invariants.failure: Failed proof construction, unsupported optional correspondence, resource exhaustion or inability to establish the exact theorem yields no truth value. Preserve UNSUPPORTED or the existing infrastructure classification; never infer falsity from compilation failure.
invariants.review: Keep all existing review counts, search completeness, ballot rules, unanimity/quorum policy, mechanical vetoes and acceptance criteria. A mechanical PASS does not satisfy a missing semantic review.

forbidden_observation_oracles.proof_dependency_rule: Audit the transitive proof dependencies of the result theorem and any proof helper used to construct it. Reject dependencies on candidate refinement/bridge proof declarations, Refines_* propositions/theorems, transfer_* or Transfer_* declarations, accepted guarantee theorems, or equivalent wrappers. Types and definitions needed to state the original accepted predicate remain available; guarantee theorems may be present in the independently replayed contract closure and remain checked by existing structural transfer audits, but must not discharge the observation proof.
forbidden_paths: Use the accepted universal guarantee or candidate refinement theorem to prove the positive ground case.
Use transfer theorems or copied guarantee lemmas through simp, exact, apply, automation or a transitive helper proof.
Accept host-evaluation truth, native_decide, evaluated runtime output, a candidate supplied Boolean or a candidate supplied confirmation receipt.
Use task-specific code generation, task names, task inputs, task answers, benchmark oracles, reference implementations or private cases.
Weaken, approximate or paraphrase the grounded residual so that a simpler predicate can be decided.
Change any budget/deadline, allow more polarity compiler invocations, relax current export limits or retry indefinitely.
Use a prompt workaround that substitutes a mechanical PASS for semantic review.
forbidden_observation_oracles.allowed_source_only_correspondence: A supervisor-derived equality connecting the actual checked source denotation with a readable source-only denotation may be used only after its exact statement, declaration/proof closure, source bindings and complete kernel replay are checked. It must not rely directly or transitively on refinement, transfer or guarantee theorem evidence.

strategy_table.recipe: Declare the exact theorem type; run the existing decide +kernel tactic without normalization.
strategy_table.purpose: Control and reproducibility of an unrelated computational gap.

strategy_table.recipe: Scope smartUnfolding false to the proof construction and perform full unfolding of permitted definitional content before decide +kernel, while declaring the result theorem with the original E or Not E.
strategy_table.purpose: Test whether a controlled transparency policy avoids the unrelated baseline construction failure.
strategy_table.eligibility: The proof state can be normalized by permitted definitions without using any forbidden observation theorem.
strategy_table.implementation_policy: Use a fixed documented tactic recipe, not unrestricted theorem search. Audit the resulting proof dependency closure. The precise recipe is frozen only after an unrelated reproducer exists.

strategy_table.recipe: Use an exact allowlist of checked source-only source_eq_* correspondences to rewrite only contributing source calls in the proof state, including their original local binders. Then apply a frozen transparency policy and decide +kernel. The theorem declaration remains the original E or Not E.
strategy_table.purpose: Test an ordinary source-only denotation as a kernel-proved normalization aid.
strategy_table.eligibility: A current source-only readable CHECKED selection exists, regeneration matches it, all required correspondences are present, and their transitive proof dependencies exclude forbidden oracles.
strategy_table.implementation_policy: Use named exact correspondences and simp only or an equivalent fixed rewrite sequence. Do not use global simp, simp_all, aesop, exact?, environment-wide proof search or candidate supplied correspondence. No new readable grammar coverage is added.
strategy_table.unsupported_boundary: BASE selection, unavailable readable constructor support, absent correspondence, failed module binding, unclosed rewritten terms or forbidden proof dependencies makes this recipe unavailable. A predeclared source-independent route may choose S-GR-001 instead before compilation; no post-failure extra compiler invocation is permitted.
evidence: selected readable descriptor and module hashes

finite_execution_policy.selected_recipe: PENDING. Each future candidate must freeze exactly one deterministic recipe or a fixed eligibility-based selection rule before execution. No recipe is selected or deemed qualified by this draft.
finite_execution_policy.proof_attempt_structure: Choose the frozen recipe without observing a host truth value. Normalize within the negative theorem proof and run decide +kernel. If ordinary construction fails with remaining budget, normalize within the positive theorem proof and run decide +kernel. Stop at the first complete kernel-accepted exact result. If both construction attempts fail, retain diagnostics and return UNSUPPORTED.
finite_execution_policy.budget_binding: All normalization, correspondence validation, diagnostic capture, library/goal preparation and independent kernel replay consume the existing shared deadline and memory/isolation limits. Neither compilation receives a fresh overall deadline. No extra per-strategy compilation/retry is introduced.
finite_execution_policy.limit_discipline: Keep all existing wire, source, formula, normative build, memory, output/export and correspondence budgets. Reject oversized optional inputs using their current limits. Freeze any proposed new diagnostic bound before qualification, without increasing existing process/output limits.
finite_execution_policy.optional_failure_policy: Optional normalization is an optimization of proof construction only. Its failure never selects a theorem polarity or produces an observed predicate. Exhaustion remains UNSUPPORTED.
finite_execution_policy.production_admission: After the hold ends, implementation remains a separately authorized new candidate. Only a recipe with all required finite qualification claims discharged by registered verifiers may be proposed for production. A candidate root cannot inherit qualification from a different implementation or verifier hash.

claim_table.statement: A fresh unrelated fixture reproduces the single-recipe gap, with both baseline polarity failures recorded; one candidate recipe constructs and independently replays the exact intended result within unchanged limits.
claim_table.pass_condition: unrelated_reproducer_exists && baseline_status == UNSUPPORTED && normalized_status in {NOT_REPRODUCED, CONFIRMED} && exact_result_kernel_accepted && limits_unchanged
block_conditions: normalized outcome lacks exact kernel evidence

claim_table.statement: The frozen minimal unrelated true and false fixtures reach their declared opposite polarities through the selected recipe.
Every definitive fixture result preserves the original grounded expression/negation and independently passes complete module replay and exact source/statement/dependency inventory checks.
Result proof and source-only normalization proof closures use no forbidden observation oracle and introduce no additional trust or axiom exception.
block_conditions: candidate Refines or bridge proof dependency

claim_table.statement: The selected normalization path preserves current limits and finite polarity order, including optional unavailable boundaries and exhaustion controls.
Failed proof construction retains bounded polarity-specific compiler diagnostics with exact sources, strategy and input identities, without asserting a specific cause absent evidence.
Frozen negative controls reject malformed, stale, oracle-dependent, unbounded and forged observations while preserving existing replay/review classifications.
Two isolated clean qualification builds reproduce the frozen recipe, exact proof types, dependency/correspondence inventories, result polarities and provenance bindings.

qualification_boundary.scope: Only the finite unrelated fixture, control, implementation and verifier bytes frozen for a later qualification run under the unchanged declared TCB. No claim of task correctness or universal replay completeness.
qualification_boundary.stop_rule: This design ends after the draft paths/hashes are returned. Do not implement or execute during the production hold.
